result.title: Weave Mamba Fusion: Global Cross-Scale Interaction for Lightweight Face Detection
result.summary: Feature pyramid methods, from FPN to BiFPN, have achieved strong performance in face detection by fusing multi-scale features. However, detecting faces under unconstrained conditions, such as small scale, occlusion, and extreme pose, remains difficult, as it requires global cross-scale dependencies that local fusion cannot model. State space models such as Mamba provide global context with linear complexity by scanning features as a sequence, and therefore offer a promising direction for this problem. Nevertheless, such a scan needs the two pyramid scales combined into a single feature map, and the way they are combined determines whether cross-scale structure is preserved. Summation collapses the two scales before the scan, so the scan has no cross-scale structure to exploit, while concatenation keeps both scales but at far higher cost. To address this, we propose \textbf{Weave Mamba Fusion (WMF)}, which interleaves two adjacent pyramid scales column by column so that each step of a horizontal bidirectional SS2D scan moves from one scale to the other. With partial-channel processing and parameter-free de-weaving, WMF enables efficient cross-scale interaction while preserving feature structure. Integrating WMF into every fusion node yields \textbf{WeaveBiFPN}, the neck of our \textbf{WeaveFace} detector. On WIDER FACE, WeaveFace achieves 91.41\% mean AP with only 0.34M parameters and 1.16 GFLOPs, outperforming prior detectors under 0.5M parameters. Its largest gains are on the Hard subset, where it reaches 87.14\% AP. The code is publicly available at \url{https://github.com/dohun-mat/WeaveMambaFusion}.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Weave Mamba Fusion，将相邻金字塔尺度按列交织后进行双向 SS2D 扫描，实现轻量人脸检测中的跨尺度特征融合，并集成到 WeaveFace 检测器。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作聚焦人脸检测的特征金字塔融合效率，未涉及 latent 推理状态生成、答案对视觉证据的使用或 THINK/LOOK/STOP 决策，缺少与 LVR/VLM 推理主线的实质联系。
